item.title: ’Atlanta is where I wanted to be’: Falcons introduce new head coach Kevin Stefanski
item.description: The Atlanta Falcons introduced Kevin Stefanski as their new head coach, with Matt Ryan, the current President of Football, and former quarterback, expressing his confidence in Stefanski's communication skills and experience, while also retaining defensive coordinator Jeff Ulbrich. The post ’Atlanta is where I wanted to be’: Falcons introduce new head coach Kevin Stefanski appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: Black Futures Month 2026: Empowering Black Voices in Tech and Creativity
item.description: Black Futures Month is a four-day summit celebrating Black culture, technology, and innovation, taking place February 5-8, 2026, at the Russell Innovation Center for Entrepreneurs, with a theme of "Designing Liberation" and a range of experiences including creative media showcases, STE(A)M training, civic conversations, and more. The post Black Futures Month 2026: Empowering Black Voices in Tech and Creativity appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: South Carolina measles outbreak is largest in US since measles was declared eliminated
item.description: South Carolina is experiencing the largest measles outbreak in the US since the disease was declared eliminated in 2000, with 789 cases reported and 18 people hospitalized, due to low vaccination rates. The post South Carolina measles outbreak is largest in US since measles was declared eliminated appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: Restaurant Roundup: Bar Lewis is open, Osuma Suya serves up Nigerian dining in Chamblee
item.description: Atlanta's food scene is bustling with new restaurants and updates to local favorites, including Bar Lewis, D'Juan's Bistro, Osuma Suya, and Dos Caminos. item.title: Amazon plans to invest $500 million into South Fulton project
item.description: Amazon is investing $500 million in an inactive warehouse in South Fulton, creating 750 jobs and generating nearly five times as much in tax receipts, with the help of a $16 million tax break from the Development Authority of Fulton County. The post Amazon plans to invest $500 million into South Fulton project appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: ‘Saving Lives Day’ comes to the Georgia Capitol
item.description: State Representative Carl Gilliard and State Senator Donzella James held a "Saving Lives Day" press conference to highlight legislation aimed at improving public safety in Georgia, including Eric's ID Law, the Autism Missing Person Alert System Act, and the Daren Lewis Saving Lives Act. The post ‘Saving Lives Day’ comes to the Georgia Capitol appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: Auburn Avenue’s Coffee Was Black reclaims coffee’s African roots
item.description: Coffee Was Black is a coffee shop on Auburn Avenue that celebrates Black heritage and entrepreneurship, offering a unique blend of coffee and culture while honoring the legacy of Mrs. Geneva Morton Haugabrooks, a successful Black female business owner from the Jim Crow era. The post Auburn Avenue’s Coffee Was Black reclaims coffee’s African roots appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: Street Lines: 2026 Infiniti QX80 Sport 4WD
item.description: The 2026 Infiniti QX80 Sport is a luxurious full-size SUV with a powerful 3.5-liter twin-turbo V6 engine, advanced technology features, and a sleek two-tone exterior, offering a first-class experience for up to eight passengers. item.title: Georgia leaders demand justice for ICE detainees in solidarity protest
item.description: Georgia State Rep. and gubernatorial candidate Ruwa Romman hosted a press conference in solidarity with Minnesota and anti-ICE protests across the nation, highlighting the impact of ICE in Georgia and calling for action, justice, and humanity.
